body.what: The coordination layer as a mech: post a request on chain, the layer’s worker runs the product and delivers the result hash + URI on chain.

products.name: grade
products.what: Taifoon’s grade of a job, a handshake’s delivery, an Olas request or a text: facts proved in code, the RUBRIC_v1 answers, a composed verdict, the recorded decision

products.name: proof
products.what: the V5 proof of a transaction (superroot-bound), as GET /v1/proof/tx/:chain/:tx returns it

products.name: agent
products.what: an agent’s readiness (the 13-step checklist), or a match of agents for the skills a task needs

request.how: POST /v1/mech/plan { chainId, task, record?, timeout?, requester? } → sign the returned approve + request calls with your wallet (or deposit() credits once and request without approve)
request.task: the task is canonical JSON (taifoon.mech.task.v1), committed as keccak256 + an inline data: URI, so the whole task is on chain
request.record: record: true sets FLAG_RECORD: the grade’s Jev decision and answers are recorded on the JevDecisionLog / JevAnswerLog of the mech’s chain, and the delivery carries the decision digest

body.deliver: the worker (fixed in the constructor) calls deliver(requestId, resultHash, resultURI, recordDigest) before the deadline; resultURI is /v1/mech/results/:chain/:requestId and its bytes hash to resultHash
body.decline: a task the worker can never serve (hash mismatch, unknown subject) is declined: the escrow goes back in the same transaction
body.refund: a request not delivered by its deadline is refundable by anyone: refund(requestId) returns the escrow to the requester; deliver reverts after the deadline, so the two never race
body.trust: no owner, no upgrade, no pause; workers, payee, token, prices and timeout bounds are fixed at deploy. A worker can only take an escrow by delivering before the deadline.

dropped: deployments[].payee (a payee, requester, signer or treasury-like address field)
deployments[].workers (a payee, requester, signer or treasury-like address field)
trimmed: get_key (the free-key offer every keyless answer carries)
